subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 3 — product consolidations (review request)

question: Should an existing explicit remote-rescue denial remain a supported security contract after this config consolidation, or may the product permanently make rescue available on every eligible owner-DM YOLO host?
rationale: The diff removes a user-controlled security denial and replaces it with a fixed default; tests can establish mechanics but cannot choose the permanent operator-security contract.

options.title: Preserve explicit opt-out
options.body: Keep a supported canonical setting or narrowly migrated denial that prevents remote rescue even on an otherwise eligible host.

options.title: Accept fixed rescue posture
options.body: Approve removal of the opt-out and document that eligible owner-DM YOLO hosts always expose the bounded rescue surface.

options.title: Pause rescue removal
options.body: Keep the existing configuration unchanged until the security contract has separate maintainer approval.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep a supported canonical setting or narrowly migrated denial that prevents remote rescue even on an otherwise eligible host.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author has assembled the product-consolidation proposal and explicitly highlighted rescue-policy removal as a review decision.
